title: Trump mulls military options, Qatar mediators return to Iran
gist: Al-Monitor's Middle East Minute podcast episode on Trump weighing military options against Iran as Qatari mediators return to Tehran, plus the Houthis denying a drone launch toward Mecca and Arab parties emerging as potential kingmakers in Israel. Only the episode description is available.
